correctness.rationale: The two-site mismatch in each W off-diagonal gives phase attenuation (1-p)^2; under amplitude damping each excitation survives with weight 1-p, with the lost weight going to the vacuum. For PD the transverse generator has no support-to-support entries, so the ordered-pair SLD expression reduces to 4 tr(rho J_x^2): the pure W value is 3N-2 and the uniform excitation mixture gives N. For AD the squared transverse matrix elements on the vacuum–W and W–two-excitation edges are N/4 and (N-1)/2. With their SLD weights this gives N(1-2p)^2+2(N-1)(1-p), including when either occupied weight becomes zero. Commutation with J_z and rotation about z give F(J_u)=(1-u_z^2)F(J_x). Factoring F_AD-N as 2(1-p)(N-1-2Np) verifies the threshold and equality points, and the convex quadratic has the stated interior minimizer and positive minimum. The N=3 comparisons agree with the 2014 channel and per-qubit conventions. The proof suffices for all N. The finite-grid program artifacts/verify.py was inspected, not executed; VERIFICATION.md supplies an expected output, not an independent numerical replay.
